en: A painted alpine landscape showing a broad lake with a dramatic mountain massif rising behind it. In the foreground are fields with red flowers, a woman and child in traditional rural clothing, and a team of horses working a field near a cottage. The style is that of an early 20th‑century chromolithograph art postcard. A small artist's signature appears in the lower right.
